swarm.done: Selected FFI use case passes layout and parity proof

arena.trigger: Two or more ABI/host boundary shapes remain viable after requirements freeze

interrogate.scope: public ABI, lifetime, layout and parity diff
interrogate.gate: Act on findings resolved or evidenced reclassification before merge/join

verification.falsifier: ABI layouts drift, foreign host owns loop/state, or parity diverges

swarm.done: Selected live core survives saturation/gap/shutdown fault injection

arena.trigger: Multiple viable bounded event/service ownership shapes exist

interrogate.scope: bounded queues, state authority, gap handling and callback isolation
interrogate.gate: Act on findings resolved or evidenced reclassification before merge/join

verification.falsifier: Unbounded queue, inline callback, silent reliable gap, competing order authority

swarm.done: Selected capabilities prove idempotency/recovery without adding unselected mechanisms

arena.trigger: Competing selected governance/recovery shapes have materially different state authority

interrogate.scope: state authority, unknown-outcome, recovery and reconciliation semantics
interrogate.gate: Act on findings resolved or evidenced reclassification before merge/join

verification.falsifier: Terminal regression, unsafe retry, unreconciled enable, replay hash mismatch

selection.predicate: D5 or production evidence + explicit capability ADR/Profile
